**8c.** Background revalidation sweep · L3861 · age triggers, premise decides; on spare capacity, never instead of the build · blocks: L3867(sql 304B)

```sql

  FROM public.backlog_items
 WHERE status NOT IN ('done','removed','removal proposed')

   AND updated_at < now() - INTERVAL '30 days'
 ORDER BY queue DESC NULLS LAST
```

**9.** Write the record, then die · L4001 · write the record; ONE statement closes your row and releases the lease; THEN the gate · blocks: L4121(sql 197B) L4234(sql 384B) L4250(sql 81B) L4268(sql 69B) L4323(sql 47B) L4366(- 72B) L4378(- 90B) L4387(- 347B) L4398(- 186B) L4429(sql 57B)

```sql
WITH released AS (
  UPDATE public.runner_lease SET holder = NULL, released_at = now(), updated_at = now()
   WHERE id = 1 AND holder = '<your cycle id>' RETURNING released_at)
UPDATE public.runner_cycles c SET ended_at = now(), outcome = '<outcome>'
 WHERE c.id = '<your cycle id>' AND c.ended_at IS NULL
RETURNING c.ended_at, (SELECT released_at FROM released) AS lease_released_at;
```
